fields.meaning: Sylvia asset (the EPUB file) the anchor belongs to.
fields.name: asset_id

fields.meaning: Digest of the EPUB bytes; a different digest means a different asset version (same-asset rules no longer apply).
fields.name: asset_digest

fields.meaning: The spine resource the text is in.
fields.name: resource_href
fields.type: string (URL path relative to the publication root, as in the OPF manifest, normalized)

fields.meaning: The selected text exactly as the reader returned it (window.getSelection().toString()): never trimmed, collapsed or truncated. Immutable (plan 11.1).
fields.name: exact_text

fields.meaning: Text before the selection as the reader returned it (Readium: up to about 200 UTF-16 code units, raw whitespace).
fields.name: prefix

fields.meaning: Text after the selection, same rules as prefix.
fields.name: suffix

fields.meaning: Where exact_text sits in Sylvia's own extraction of resource_href: {unit: "unicode_scalar", basis: "sylvia-extraction", extraction_version, block_index, start, end}. Null when the selection spans blocks or is ambiguous. Units are Unicode scalars (Contracts/README.md); the adapter converts to UTF-16 for the DOM.
fields.name: text_offsets

fields.meaning: Readium's progression within the resource of the page shown at capture time (Readium 3.11.0 copies the navigator's current location into the selection locator; it is not the selection's own position). Null when the adapter had to correct the resource. Display and coarse fallback only; changes with layout.
fields.name: progression

fields.meaning: Progression within the publication. Display only.
fields.name: total_progression

fields.meaning: Readium position number (synthetic, about 1,024 characters per position). Never shown as a page number (plan 7.5).
fields.name: position

fields.meaning: {index, count} when one quotation crosses resources and is stored as several ordered anchors; null for a single anchor.
fields.name: segment

fields.meaning: Reader release that produced the locator (3.11.0).
fields.name: reader.adapter_version

fields.meaning: Readium Locator JSON verbatim (href, type, title, locations, text). Adapter-opaque: other clients must not interpret it; they use the portable fields.
fields.name: reader.locator

envelope_proposal.observed_readium_locator_contents: Selection locators carry href, type, title, locations.{progression, totalProgression, position} and text.{before, highlight, after}; no CSS selector, partial CFI, DOM range or fragment. Content-iterator (extraction and search-hit) locators also carry locations.cssSelector. Reading-position locators carry no text.highlight. Readium 3.11.0 builds a selection locator from the navigator's current location (href, progression, position of the page shown) plus the selected text, so right after a jump its href can name the previous resource; the adapter's captureSelection() checks the href against the document holding the selection (readium_selection_href_vs_confirmed).
envelope_proposal.summary: Portable fields are Sylvia's own and readable on any platform; reader.locator is the reader's locator stored verbatim and interpreted only by the adapter named in reader.adapter. Reanchoring order (plan 7.5): reader.locator, then exact_text with prefix/suffix inside resource_href, then text_offsets when extraction_version matches.
